definitions.margin: Two-party Democratic margin in percentage points: 100 * (D - R) / (D + R). Positive favors the Democrat. Third-party votes are excluded from the denominator.
definitions.swing: Difference between two margins for the same geography, in points. Positive means movement toward Democrats.
definitions.est_gov_2026_margin: Estimate: the district's 2024 presidential margin (exact, from precinct returns on 2022 lines) plus the governor-minus-president county swing of each county the district touches, weighted by 2026 legislative votes cast in that county piece. An estimate until precinct results are certified.
definitions.mail_share: Mail-in and absentee ballots as a share of all votes in the race.
definitions.votes_vs_2024_pct: Votes cast in the 2026 governor's race as a percentage of votes cast in the 2024 presidential race in the same county.
definitions.contested: Both a Democratic-side and a Republican candidate received votes.
definitions.unofficial: Every 2026 figure is the county's unofficial tally as published by the Department of State. Provisional ballots were largely not yet included when these files were built.
